_comment: Per-frame profiles. Same board (YD_F102_MIPI_V3.0), different LCD panels. Frame 1 runs the seller's kernel unchanged; frame 2 needs the panel-init patch below. Never flash one frame's image on the other.

1.title: Frame 1 (works on the seller's kernel)
1.panel_id: not captured yet (needs a UART boot log of frame 1: line 'mipi id read ok')
1.kernel: stock 16.10, no kernel patch, config untouched

2.title: Frame 2 (needs panel init patch)
2.kernel: stock 16.10 + replaced ILI9881 init routine (table linux_k101_im2byl02_init) + stock auto_mipi timing
